title: GPOM Second Half E: The Ending
heading: GitPush Origin Master ▲ second half E: the ending
about: A woman on a bus is watching this film. Zoom out down an ordinary high street. The AI's last line. No "We are BadCode". Stage 1 written brief: brief.md; music: music.md.
stage: 1 (written brief, no interview: the 2026-10-21 autonomous run, second-half-ending-goal.md)

maddie.rule: ALWAYS this reference; the torn bunting stays in every shot
maddie.voice: Gemini TTS Aoede (Bristol, the plan's bot profile)

ai.rule: No body, ever. Speaks through Maddie's speaker (beacon pulses on his words); the last line of the film is the one unfiltered read
ai.voice: Suno Voice "badcode newsreader" (the AI), dry, through Maddie's speaker: small-speaker filter, beacon pulses on his words

building.rule: ONE fixed design: a long, low building of black glass, many times longer than it is tall, with one single thin horizontal seam of warm amber light running its whole length, set down in a fold between two green chalk downs, the only made thing in sight; no windows, no signs, no other lights
building.note: Design anchor = the BL series (BL1-day, BL2-dusk, BL4-seam-opens, BL5-aerial; second-half-moodboard.md). L11-exterior-night is NOT this design (a tall near-cubic block, seam part-way) and is not used.

beats.name: The bus
beats.blurb: Hard cut on sound: rain, traffic, a bus. A woman on the top deck is watching this film on her phone. Tinny, through the phone: Maddie, "Mind how you go."

lines.speaker: maddie
lines.voice: Gemini TTS Aoede (Bristol, the plan's bot profile)
lines.how: soft, after a long silence, to the empty chairs; gentle and a little lost, trying to be cheerful for nobody
lines.was: ...you go. (the tail of D16's take, split across the cut)
lines.note: Kai round 1 (ld9-1, le1-0): moved whole from D16; voiced in D's room, then the phone filter

beats.name: She looks up
beats.blurb: Over her shoulder: the empty chairs on her screen, her own high street through the wet window. She looks up from one to the other.

beats.name: The bus drives away
beats.blurb: Zoom out as a red double-decker pulls away down an ordinary high street at night. The AI, for the first time unfiltered, close: the last line.

lines.speaker: ai
lines.voice: Suno Voice "badcode newsreader" (the AI): "I made it." with a 40% trace of Maddie's speaker filter, the rest full range and close (the first time unfiltered)
lines.text: I made it. Now we have some work to do.
lines.how: dry, close, tired on 'I made it.'; then warmer and quietly determined: an invitation to get on with it, not a threat or an order

alt.text: I made it. They didn't. Don't let the same lot make me come back twice.
alt.also: I made it. They didn't. Don't make me come back twice. (gpom-sh-end-ai-e1, Kai's canon)
alt.note: Review round 2: draft 4 was still heard as a threat and an instruction to the viewer (brief E: no call to action); a warmer Suno re-take could not be recorded, so the imperative is dropped. Both longer versions are in the same take. **Kai to rule** by ear.

lines.note: Kai round 1 (le3-0): this is the ending. Owed as a Suno newsreader take; not voiced in Gemini.

frames.purpose: Rhyme and regress: the film is on her phone. The last thing she heard is the last thing we heard.

frames.purpose: From the screen to the street: she is the "you" the hundred paid for, on an ordinary night, in an ordinary town.

still.prompt: Using the first image for the woman and the bus and the second for the street: over the shoulder of the same woman on the top deck of the bus at night, her phone in her hand with its screen dimmed, rain streaming down the window beside her. Through the wet glass, her own ordinary high street: a chip shop, a pharmacy, a betting shop, and a closed bank, its windows whitewashed, a blank estate agent's board above the door, lights smeared by the rain. She has lowered the phone a little and is looking out of the window. 16:9 frame from a fictional near-future British film. Full-frame image, no captions, logos, lettering or on-screen text.
still.model: Nano Banana Pro via flow_edit_image (0 credits), 2 candidates a call

motion.prompt: The camera does not move. Rain streams down the window and the street lights slide past outside. The woman lowers her phone to her lap and turns her head to look out at the street. The camera does not move.

frames.purpose: The zoom out: one bus on one high street, and the whole film becomes a thing a stranger watched on the way home. The last line lands on it.
